title: WU LEI HAO LING · A THUNDER-RITE COMMAND TALISMAN, WRITTEN
subtitle: DAOFA HUIYUAN DZ 1220, juan 46 · iron plate, five cun by three · written in cinnabar · stroke medians from makemeahanzi
footer: Never invert the brush and tap for a pregnant woman or a patient with eye disease. · SigilCompose study · no CJK font is loaded: every Han graph here is a written stroke

registers.words: FU TOU  head  · 3 hooks, 3 Pure Ones
FU JIAO  foot · one breath, 38 strokes

head.heading: TA FU TOU · TREADING THE HEAD
lines: 3rd stroke  malign gods, a thousand li hence

gall.heading: SUNG WHILE GANG IS DRAWN
gall.note: the sixth phrase lands on the tenth stroke

law.heading: QI / XING / SHOU · THE WIDTH OVER ONE STROKE
law.note: The brush enters against its own direction, thins through the body and presses before it lifts. Every stroke on the plate is laid by this one law.

chant.heading: ZHAN HONG FU · SEVER THE RAINBOW
lines: SHANG DI YOU LING      The High Emperor has commanded:
YAO NI MIE XING        demon-rainbow, annihilate its form.
FENG DAO CUN ZHAN      The wind-blade cuts it inch by inch.
QING KE LIU XING       In an instant, a shooting star.
JI JI RU LU LING       Swiftly, swiftly, per the statutes.
chant.gloss: “急急如律令” is the Han imperial-document closing formula, borrowed whole. It ends almost every fu, and it goes at the FOOT.

tempo.heading: YI QI LI DUAN · CUT OFF IN ONE BREATH
tempo.gloss: the foot is 7.1x the body — doctrine, measured: "the foot is the last step; total concentration, cut off in a single breath, no slowing or dragging."  A fu written at one tempo is not a fu.

tread.heading: BU GANG TA DOU · THE TREAD, ON THE REAL DIPPER
lines: Nine stations: J2000 right ascension and declination, gnomonically projected about the asterism's own centroid. Yu bu is "three steps, nine prints".

Zuo Fu (Alcor) lies 0.008 of the asterism's span from Kai Yang (Mizar) on the real sky — every bu gang plate separates the pair by hand, and so does this one. You Bi is invisible: its station is doctrine, and it is drawn open.
